thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1749991234 - cross-region probe weighting regression detected. Routing telemetry shows sudden shift in probe weighting causing EU-origin traffic to prefer APAC egress for ~08:12-08:20 UTC. Potential customer latency and failed request increase. Pager triggered for oncall.
oncall-alex: I'm on it. TL;DR impact?
netops-sam: Initial telemetry: RTT EU->APAC up ~3x, p50 120ms -> 380ms, error rate (5xx) from 0.6% -> 6% for API gateway route id rgw-71.
sre-maria: Confirmed — steering service pushed a weight recalculation job at 08:11 UTC (job-id: wcalc-2026-03-17-0811). Looks like one probe group returned stale health leading to aggressive weighting to APAC.
support-jordan: We already have a small wave of customer reports: increased timeouts for embeddings endpoints from EU customers. I've started a triage ticket: CID-8342.
eng-runtime: Any config rollouts around that time? I don't see a canary flagged but there was a config tweak to probe sampling in the scheduler yesterday. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/probe-scheduler/pulls/442
oncall-alex: Ok, mitigation suggestion? Can we force pin EU egress for impacted routes while we debug weighting?
netops-sam: We can apply a temporary pin rule in steering: set route-policy rgw-71 -> prefer eu-west2 with weight 100 for 10m. Doing it now.
netops-sam: @oncall-alex applied pin:```
set-steering-policy --route rgw-71 --prefer-region eu-west2 --weight 100 --ttl 600 --reason "emergency pin due to probe-weight regression"
```
netops-sam: Pin accepted by control plane, propagation to edge should be within 30s.
sre-maria: Adding KV cache bypass on the routing layer for rgw-71 to avoid selecting cached (stale) policy during rollouts. Patch applied.
eng-runtime: I'm running a quick rollback of the sampling tweak in staging to reproduce. If we can reproduce, we'll patch tomorrow morning.
support-jordan: Customer impact update: ~18 customers reported latency spikes, 4 distinct accounts saw >10% errors for 3-8 minutes. No billing impacts reported yet. Logging tickets with customers.
product-liz: Flagging high-value accounts in the affected set so SEs can prioritize outreach.
oncall-alex: Good. Next: root cause investigation plan — Sam to export probe telemetry for the 08:05-08:25 window, Maria to correlate steering decisions with job wcalc-2026-03-17-0811, Eng-runtime to attempt repro in staging, Support to gather customer logs. We'll meet in 15.
netops-sam: Export started: probe_dump_1749991234.tar.gz -> s3://redwood-incident-exports/1749991234/probe_dump.tar.gz
sre-maria: Correlating steering decision log:```
[08:11:05] wcalc-2026-03-17-0811 START
[08:11:10] probe-group eu-west2 health score: 0.16 (stale: true)
[08:11:12] computed weights -> apac:0.88 eu:0.12
[08:11:13] policy push -> applied
[08:18:40] wcalc job marked completed
```
eng-runtime: Repro attempt: when I force a probe-group to return stale health we do bias weighting. Looks like the scheduler's fallback assigns a high weight to the other region instead of evenly distributing. Repro steps saved in gist: https://gist.internal/repro-1749991234
sre-maria: Rolling forward mitigation: adjust probe sampling timeout from 45s -> 15s to reduce stale reads. Applying on canary now.
netops-sam: Canary applied; watching telemetry.
support-jordan: Customer update drafted and sent to impacted accounts with workaround (retry policy + regional pin suggestion). No escalations yet.
oncall-alex: Any risk to broader traffic? Is this isolated to rgw-71 or systemic?
eng-runtime: Pattern suggests any route using the legacy probe-group aggregation could be affected. We're checking other route ids now.
sre-maria: Scan results: 3 additional low-traffic routes briefly saw similar weight shifts but the emergency pin prevented customer impact.
netops-sam: Telemetry post-mitigation (08:20 UTC onwards): p50 back to ~130ms, error rate down to ~0.8%. Pin TTL will be 10m; we'll remove once stable for 5m.
oncall-alex: Handoff plan: I'll stay on for the next 30min, then hand to @sre-maria if still ongoing. Please add all findings to the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/1749991234.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> Sev2 (customer impact, mitigated). Incident channel: #incidents. Pager silenced at 08:25 UTC.
support-jordan: Final customer impact summary to include: window 08:11-08:20 UTC, ~4 accounts with >10% errors, broader set (~18) saw latency increases, mitigation via regional pin and probe sampling tweak.
product-liz: Please include recommended follow-ups: revert legacy probe-group fallback to safer distribution, add alert for abrupt probe-weight changes, run a runbook review.
oncall-alex: Agreed. I'll own the follow-ups with Sam and Maria. Closing updates in 1h assuming stable. :thumbsup:
